digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate and attestation evidence contract
propositions: Operator-attested criteria lack deterministic enforcement of measurement provenance context (environment, principal, privilege posture, instrument type), allowing claims whose observations could not have failed for the reasons they claim to rule out

World-grounded measurements taken under broader privilege than production (e.g., under bedrock:* wildcard when production is scoped to bedrock:InvokeModel) or via instruments that cannot observe the actual failure mode (simulation vs live call) generate evidence structurally unable to detect the defect

Plan assertions of unchanged behavior across configuration/provider/route swaps are invisible to review when they do not cite the resolution paths those configurations feed through, allowing repos-checkable defects to evade gate detection
The completion-verifier must not re-measure world state to validate provenance, as its own credentials carry the same privilege-masking problem and would validate using the instrument under suspicion

Measurement provenance must be forced into the attestation record as readable text fields (environment, principal, privilege_posture, instrument) enforced deterministically, then judged by LLM criteria against repo facts for contradictions
